things that instantly make
you more interesting

having a strange hobby

pick up one unusual hobby: fencing, beekeeping, calligraphy. people are always curious about the person with a hobby they've never even heard of before.

having opinions about books

read a few books that genuinely move you and have real thoughts about them. people love talking to someone who reads widely and actually thinks about it.

knowing odd facts

spend 5 minutes a day learning one odd fact: why cats purr, how old the moon is, who invented the sandwich. odd facts are the easiest way to become interesting.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing odd facts

i spend 5 minutes a day learning one odd fact, like why cats purr. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and odd facts are the easiest way to become interesting.

slides.texte_overlay:
telling stories well

practise telling short stories with a beginning, a twist and an end. a good storyteller is magnetic at every table, and it's a skill anyone can learn.

being curious about others

ask people questions about their lives and actually listen. the most interesting people are almost always the ones most genuinely interested in everyone else.
